cases.uq: Retrieve PK data from 'Curated Drug Pharmacokinetic Data' source in ChEMBL for drug LEVOFLOXACIN. Return DISTINCT title, dataset, assay_id, description, dosed_compound_name, dose, dosage_form, regimen, route, gender, age_range, health_status, tissue, molregno, compound_name, activity_id, toid, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and activity_comment. Preserve the PK-specific join path source -> compound_records -> docs -> activities using both record_id and doc_id, then join activity_properties and assay_parameters to pivot the PK context fields. The dataset field must come from assay_parameters where standard_type = 'DATASET'. The description field must come from assays.description. The dosed_compound_name, dose, dosage_form, regimen, route, gender, age_range, health_status, and tissue fields come from activity_properties using these raw standard_type codes exactly: DOSED_COMPOUND_NAME, DOSE, DOSAGE_FORM, REGIMEN, ROUTE, GENDER, AGE_RANGE, HEALTH_STATUS, and TISSUE. Render DOSED_COMPOUND_NAME, DOSE, DOSAGE_FORM, and REGIMEN from COALESCE(CAST(standard_value AS TEXT), standard_text_value) together with standard_units when present. Render ROUTE, GENDER, AGE_RANGE, HEALTH_STATUS, and TISSUE from COALESCE(CAST(standard_value AS TEXT), standard_text_value).
